name: Octafoil Mirror with Two Immortals Crossing the Ocean
dimensions: Diameter: 17.6 cm (6 15/16 in.); Overall: 1 cm (3/8 in.); Rim: 0.6 cm (1/4 in.)
summary: This mirror in the shape of a flower represents two immortals crossing the ocean, surrounded by surging waves.
